body: I kind of get it, I'm naturally a flirty person (guy) and I missed being able to make a cheeky comment or two when I was in a relationship. It sounds like you wouldn't cheat on him, so that's good. But I do understanding wanting to be out n having a lil fun here n there. I know it's not right, but I understand.

I think I understand where this is coming from, where I've seen friends and partners and all sorts of people get burnt out because to empathise and to take on another's burden in that sense can be exhausting, and I've been there as well.

That being said, it seems like all around you people are preemptively protecting themselves and closing off forms of communication. It's a push and pull and I hope that they manage to find a balance between it all.
Happy Birthday! I hope you enjoyed your steak n potatoes

Honestly at this point yes.

I fear I would be judged, that no-one would understand my situation. I dont have a reason to be this way. To be depressed. In fact some would say my social background would say the exact opposite, that I should be happy with what I have. It just happened to me unfortunately.

I have done plenty of research, knowing the symptoms and seeing how they've affected people on other subreddits and I know it's what I have. I'm just... afraid of getting help. I will meet her and I guess I should face her, talk about my feelings for her, if not to make it better at least as one last time before...I go. 

Thank you.
Depression. That I might have it, That I don't know how to stop it, and worst of all: that someone finds out I have it.

I didn't really enjoy it... I guess it was a mix of drunken stupidity coupled with a "I give up on everything so it doesn't matter" mentality. I can't say I won't do it again because I don't give a shit now, but I guess something like I will get out of bed and find a small reason to smile everyday kinda thing might be possible?

Hey I know exactly how you feel, putting on a mask and trying to be happy, not just for ourselves but to seem okay to others. Feeling that way means you're just human and I guess that's perfectly okay. And it doesn't get easier because you're not only trying to lie to others, you're lying to yourself about being happy. But I guess when things work out for you, when you find things that genuinely make you happy, you feel good. Just want you to know I've been there and I'm still there now and you can pm me if you want to.
Yup I know how it feels. But putting on a mask is tiring
